steps: The built-in shared-state starter is available, reviewed and cancelled without any author writes.
A-B-A shares a visit counter, key flag and Chinese/Japanese/emoji string; deletion remains traceable, and read-only filtering and state cards work in three languages at 390px.
A second owned run starts from empty revision 0, clears the previous filter and reaches the same six mutations; no session state is restored from disk.
The same A-B-A transition sequence also reaches ready in a native Godot window; the task survives panel close/reopen and explicit cancellation stops the owned session.

The visible multi-scene project is reviewed, downloaded, independently verified, extracted elsewhere and started by real Godot with the identical A-B-A visit sequence and identical shared-state mutations and audio shutdown between scenes.
Clicking the last shared-state mutation opens the frozen behavior declaration without changing author files; text-range positioning is asserted only when the frozen source supplies a range.
